- `tools/orch/instrument/instrument/core/milestone.py` calls it once, in `_publish_task` (line 770), as `owner_publishes(resolve_owner())`.
- `tools/orch/runner/runner/core/engine.py` calls it in `run_task` (lines 480 and 565).
- `tools/orch/runner/runner/core/hooks.py` calls it in `_finalize_cleanup` (line 2001).
- `tools/orch/runner/runner/core/state.py` calls it in `do_transition` (line 505).
- `tools/orch/dao-cli/dao_cli/board.py` calls it at lines 377, 483, 600, 777, 803 and 829, across `run_boards_init`, `fields_cmd`, `load_board_config` and the three `set_board_*` functions.
- `tools/orch/dao-cli/dao_cli/task.py` calls it at lines 563, 618, 632 and 1174, in `update` and `_publish_task_locked`.
- `tools/orch/dao-cli/dao_cli/project.py` calls it in `init` (line 125), as `resolve_owner(explicit=owner)`.

The definition itself is in `tools/orch/dao-cli/dao_cli/core/project.py` (line 471). It is being changed, so I left it out of the list.

Many callers pass the result straight into string-typed parameters such as `owner_publishes(...)`, `owner: str | None` and `resolved_owner`. Those call sites need a look as well as the calls.

I changed no files.
